decisions: Public special represents a button press, not an assignment of attack mode. Typed player inputs carry no caller damage, timing or desired form. Engine state selects the admitted packet.

Adler/Nanally/Jiuyuan special enters aiming without a damage packet. Subsequent attacks select native Aim damage. Repeated special toggles off; admitted dodge/skill/burst and field exit exit aiming. Wait and no-op swap preserve it. Reported controls support reset behavior; toggle and timing remain hypotheses.

Lacrimosa keeps the existing ranged initial form. Flavor Variation selects current-form damage before switching at admission. Dodge resets the ordinary chain while preserving form. Skill/burst and field exit preserve form.

Lacrimosa melee stage ratios bind uniquely to native B_Melee rows: 0.642+0.232; 0.199*2; 0.246+0.147*3; 0.709+0.273; 0.233*3+1.233. A consecutive grounded third stage adds one 0.194 projectile explosion under a nearby-target hypothesis. Spatial misses and projectile persistence across interruption are not established.
Melee-form truck ultimate binds to 2.533*2+0.427*5+0.933*3 = 10 ATK; ranged-form car remains 0.942*4+6.233 = 10.001 ATK.

Melee-to-ranged Flavor Variation prose says one instance per target, while published damage ratios specify 40%*2. Retain the numeric two-packet interpretation as a disclosed hypothesis; ranged-to-melee uses one 79% packet.

Input timing is an explicit research hypothesis: special 800ms, dodge 500ms, zero energy and no cooldown. Recovery admission is enforced; cancellation, stamina, invulnerability and critical dodge are unsupported. Other owners reject explicitly.
checks: crates/content/src/simulation/tests/player_inputs.rs: independent coefficients, both forms and truck, dodge reset/persistence, failed admission, reached assumptions without hits, delayed packet identity and normal-talent/resonance selection
web/tests/player_inputs.test.mjs: authored comma lists/repeaters, exact sequential timestamps, native packet/damage oracles, Worker execution and optional whole-report CLI/WASM parity
return_conditions: Native transition/animation evidence can replace initial-form, repeated-G toggle, transition moment and input timing hypotheses.
Projectile position/contact evidence can replace the guaranteed uninterrupted stage-three shatter hypothesis.
Connect stamina/enemy attack and cancellation models before claiming full dodge behavior.
